market_name: Will no Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm which direction the market's implied prob moved and check 2y/10y yields and fed funds futures for a corroborating hawkish shift.
time_plan.1h: Check whether any Fed speaker, CPI/PCE, or jobs data explains the move (i.e., already-public catalyst) vs. an unexplained leak.
time_plan.2h: Re-check TLT vs. Treasury futures; assess whether move is persisting or mean-reverting.
time_plan.6h: Compare against SOFR/fed funds futures repricing to see if the anomaly is confirmed by rates markets.
time_plan.12h: Measure realized TLT move vs. expectation; flag whether it reached the 700bps tradable threshold (very unlikely) and log reversal if any.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 'no Fed cuts in 2026' is a hawkish repricing of the rate path. Fewer expected cuts pushes the terminal rate and the front-to-belly of the curve higher, lifting yields and pressuring long-duration bond prices. TLT is the most liquid clean proxy for duration. Note the mapping only holds if the probability moved UP; a falling probability (more cuts priced) would flip the sign.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Verify direction of the prob move and check DXY / EURUSD for confirmation.
time_plan.1h: Determine if any scheduled macro release drove both the market and FX simultaneously.
time_plan.2h: Check whether dollar strength is broad-based or idiosyncratic to one cross.
time_plan.6h: Reassess rate-differential story vs. risk-off flows that could independently move USD.
time_plan.12h: Compare realized UUP move to expectation; note it will fall far short of the 700bps tradable bar.

predictions.reasoning: Hawkish repricing (higher-for-longer Fed) typically supports the dollar via widening rate differentials. A jump in 'no cuts 2026' probability would, on the margin, be dollar-positive. UUP is a liquid DXY proxy. This is a weaker, second-order link with small expected magnitude.

evidence_used: Market question resolves on count of 25bp Fed cuts in 2026; 'No cuts' = maximally hawkish outcome
Description clarifies emergency cuts count and early 'No' resolution if strike becomes impossible
Standard macro linkage: fewer expected cuts -> higher yields, stronger USD
uncertainty_notes: Direction of the asset mapping fully depends on which way the implied probability moved; a dovish move flips all signs
The 700bps tradable threshold is implausible for rate-sensitive ETFs over 12h; expected moves are an order of magnitude smaller
Fed-path repricing is usually driven by public data (CPI, jobs, Fed speak), so leakage/edge is questionable
'Military_conflict' primary topic tag appears mislabeled for a Fed market, reducing confidence in metadata

llm_justification.summary: This market tracks whether the Fed makes zero 25bp cuts in 2026 — a pure hawkish/dovish rate-path gauge. A sharp rise in the 'no cuts' probability implies higher-for-longer policy, which maps to lower long-duration Treasury prices (TLT down) and a modestly stronger dollar (UUP up). Both links are directionally sound but small in magnitude and highly conditional on the direction of the probability shift; neither approaches the 700bps tradable bar over 12 hours.
key_assumptions: A meaningful, directional move occurred in the market's implied probability
'No cuts' probability rising = hawkish repricing (assumed direction for the mapping)
Standard rate-path-to-asset transmission holds within a 12h window
failure_modes: The probability move was dovish (more cuts priced), flipping TLT to up and UUP to down
The catalyst was already public (data print or Fed speech), so no informational edge exists
Rate-path news moves ETFs far less than 700bps in 12h, so signal is untradable by the stated threshold
USD linkage is weak/second-order and can be overwhelmed by risk sentiment or cross-currency idiosyncrasies
Prediction market may be thinly traded/noisy, producing false signals unrelated to real rate expectations
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
